module: Small tool for level designers (Debug > "Viz Helper" menu): it places dynamic decals of images taken from art/vizhelper/ at the spot targeted by the mouse in the 3D view, to mark things. Wheel = rotation, Ctrl+wheel = size, Alt+wheel = change image, Shift = sensitivity x10, left click = place (held = paint with a minimum distance).
notes: The placed decals are kept in a local table savedDecals and redisplayed on every onUpdate via Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals; they are cleared when the editor is deactivated (onEditorDeactivated) or by the "clear" button. They are not saved in the level.
The images are listed when the extension loads (FS:findFiles on art/vizhelper/); if the folder is empty, vizHelper[curItem+1] is nil and the path concatenation fails.
Windowing uses im.Begin directly (a TODO in the code plans to switch to editor.beginWindow).
Fixed decal values: fadeStart 2000, fadeEnd 2500 (m), uniform scale = Size, forwardVec rotated around the normal.

windowOpen.desc: Open/closed state of the window; read/write with windowOpen[0].

openWindow.desc: Opens the Viz Helper window (windowOpen[0] = true).

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the window, handles input (wheel, click), does a cameraMouseRayCast, draws a green sphere at the targeted point and adds the preview decal or saves it.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook: adds the "Viz Helper" menu entry (Debug group).

onEditorActivated.desc: Editor hook called on activation; does nothing.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Editor hook called on deactivation: clears savedDecals.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Extension hook called on load: lists the files in art/vizhelper/ and builds the dropdown list string.

onUpdate.desc: Extension hook called every frame: redisplays all saved decals.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: returns {windowOpen = bool}.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload: restores the window's open state.
